title: A reduced-order model for parametrized Optimal Transport problems
summary: In this work, we aim at efficiently solving a parametrized family of optimal transport problems by using model order reduction methods. We propose a reduced-order model by adding to the primal (respectively dual) version of the high-fidelity model the additional constraint to live in a non negative sub cone (resp. in subspaces) of small dimension. The reduced-order model then reads as a linear program with a small number of degrees of freedom and constraints.
